TAL_SOUND_RESONANT_NOTE.label: Resonant Note
TAL_SOUND_RESONANT_NOTE.why: 'Target: One creature or object you can perceive ... If the target is an unattended object, brittle structure, ordinary barrier, or construct, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage': aimed at a placed object it rolls its Sound Cultivation Attack against the object's AC and deals its damage (plus Proficiency Bonus for an unattended object) (combat/ext/objects.py). Barriers and constructs are not map objects.
